title: Self-healing CI/CD pipeline
sub: One failing push, one fix pull request. A recorded run from 2026-11-15.

title: The parts
sub: A GitHub repository with Actions, an n8n workflow of 26 nodes, and Qwen3.8-27B served from a Kaggle notebook with two T4 GPUs.

caption: The n8n workflow that does the healing. The two nodes at the bottom left store the model address.
1. A commit deletes one line in formatGreeting, so the variable clean is no longer defined.
2. GitHub Actions runs the tests on every push to main.
3. The build-and-test job fails after 9 s. The notify job, which calls n8n, runs and passes.
4. The log shows ReferenceError: clean is not defined, and the step labels the failure failure_kind=code.
5. n8n received the webhook. The execution finished in 18.7 s with every node green.
6a. Left half of the run: receive the webhook, fetch the job log and changed files, pick the files, build the prompt.
6b. Right half: ask Qwen3.8, rebuild the streamed reply, extract the edit, create the branch, push the file, open the pull request.
7. A pull request opens from the branch ai-fix-format-greeting-4da7e41.
8. The edit replaces ${clean} with ${name}. It makes the tests pass but drops the original trim, so a person still has to review it.
9. CI runs on the pull request and passes. Nothing is merged until a person does it.

title: From push to pull request in about a minute
sub: CI failed in 16 s, the n8n run took 18.7 s, CI on the fix took 12 s. Source: GitHub Actions and n8n execution 2.
